description: Creates a proposal in Taseli for a new campaign on a topic, planned with AI from the business brief and memory. Google Ads: Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen or an App campaign for installs (type; left out, Taseli picks by the business and its stage; a Search campaign for a business paid by phone calls starts with its phone number as a call asset). Meta can also run call ads (route call) or store-visit ads (route store). The owner's explicit choices (type, daily budget, route, match, bidding) are honored even against Taseli's advice: the advice comes back once in the answer; only what the platform itself can't run is refused. Meta: a whole Facebook + Instagram campaign from scratch (WhatsApp, an instant form or the website; 2-3 ads from the business's best pictures; a broad audience in its area), also for an empty account. TikTok: a whole TikTok campaign from scratch (purchases or leads counted by the pixel, an instant form, or visits; 1-3 vertical videos, or the owner's own post as a Spark ad with spark_code), also for an empty account. The owner approves it in Taseli; it is built switched off and spends nothing until turned on. Nothing changes in the ad account here. Not on read-only accounts. Creatives for Meta and TikTok campaigns come from the library, by id. The same request_id (or the same topic while the first proposal is still open) returns the same proposal.

account.description: The Google Ads, Meta or TikTok account's name (or id); needed when the business has more than one.

ad_set.description: Meta only: a running ad set (exact name or id) to add 1-3 new ads into instead of building a new campaign.

app_url.description: Google App campaign only: the app's store page (Google Play or App Store link).

bidding.description: Google Search only: the bidding, when the owner chose one.

creative_ids.description: Meta and TikTok: library creatives to use (creative ids; videos for TikTok). A Google build picks the library's pictures and videos itself (videos need no YouTube channel).

daily_budget.description: The owner's own daily budget, in the account's currency (Google, Meta and TikTok).

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

match.description: Google Search only: the keyword match type, when the owner chose one.

page_id.description: Meta only: the Facebook Page the ads speak as (id or exact name), when the answer listed several and the owner chose.

privacy_url.description: Meta only: the owner's privacy policy link, for an instant form.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key, up to 64 characters: a retry with the same key never makes a second proposal.

route.description: Meta and TikTok: where people go, when the owner chose (TikTok: form, site_leads, site_sales or traffic). Meta call: a call button that dials the business (needs its phone number); Meta store: people to the nearest branch (needs the business's locations in Meta). Both need the goal model on.

spark_code.description: TikTok only: a Spark Ads code the owner made for one of their own TikTok posts.

topic.description: What the campaign is about, e.g. 'bathroom remodels'.

type.description: Google Ads only: the campaign type, when the owner chose one. app: an App campaign for installs of the business's app (needs app_url or a saved store link, and installs counted through Firebase or the app's measurement partner; the answer says what is missing).

title: Propose a new campaign
